integrity: The assertion is supported by a complete analytic proof; checker.py contains reproducible corroborating finite evaluations, not an infinite proof. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to a sparse monic quadratic with independent circular complex Gaussian anti-analytic coefficient and target; not the full random Kac quadratic ensemble. Numeric decimals are quadrature values, not rigorously enclosed decimals. Historical originality is qualified by incomplete access to some harmonic-trinomial literature.
title: Gaussian four-zero law for sparse random harmonic quadratics
